quests.title: What Comes Up
quests.description: Shadow Hunter Vokra holds Heartwatch because of the Heartwood Hollow behind it. The rot climbs up out of the heartwood and along the Rotting Bough, and the Blightgrubs come up with it.
quests.accept_text: The rot comes up out of the heartwood and spreads along the Rotting Bough, and the Blightgrubs ride it like a tide. They eat the soft wood and leave the rot room to grow, so it's spreading faster every week. Go out on the bough and kill them.
quests.turn_in_text:
Good, that's the first push. They'll come back, but slower.

Before the merge the shadow hunters didn't come up here at all. Now we've got a watch, and a door we don't open.

quests.title: The Rot's Heart
quests.description: Vokra wants to know where the rot on the Rotting Bough is worst, and she wants the Rotheart Treants there cut down before they spread it any further.

objectives.label: Find where the rot is worst on the Rotting Bough

quests.accept_text: Somewhere out along the Rotting Bough the rot's thickest, and the Rotheart Treants stand in it like they're guarding it. Find the place and cut them down. I need to know how bad it's got.
quests.turn_in_text:
The bark's gone soft right through, you say, and there's sap coming up black. That's worse than I'd hoped.

Something down in the heartwood is feeding it. The rot isn't the sickness, it's the sign of it.

quests.title: Old Barkrot
quests.description: The oldest of the rotting treants has rooted itself in the worst of the rot on the Rotting Bough. The shadow hunters call it Old Barkrot, and the rot spreads fastest round it.
quests.accept_text: There's one treant on the Rotting Bough older and bigger than the rest, and the rot spreads fastest round it. We call it Old Barkrot. It's put down roots in the rot, and it won't move unless something makes it.
quests.turn_in_text:
Old Barkrot's down, and the bough already smells cleaner.

That buys us time. Now I want you to see the door we're watching, so you understand what the time's for.

quests.title: Sealed for Now
quests.description: Vokra wants you to stand at the Heartwood Hollow behind Heartwatch and listen, so you know what the watch is for. The shadow hunters sealed it, and nobody goes in until the tribes say so.

objectives.label: Stand at the Heartwood Hollow and listen

quests.accept_text: Go and stand at the split behind me and put your ear to the seal. Don't touch it. Just listen, and then come back and tell me what you heard.
quests.turn_in_text:
Chewing, slow and steady, and something breathing between the bites. Yes, that's what we hear too.

We don't go in until the High Chieftain says we're ready. When he does, I'll want you with us.

quests.title: Listening to the Tree
quests.description: Loa-Speaker Ganjo hears the tree groaning at night, and he wants to know where it hurts. The first climbers built their shrines where the tree spoke loudest.

objectives.label: Listen at the old shrine on the Lichen Reach
Listen at the old tower on the south terraces
Listen at the far end of the Rotting Bough

quests.accept_text: The first climbers put their shrines where the tree's voice was loudest. Go and stand at the old shrine on the Lichen Reach, the old tower on the south terraces, and the far end of the Rotting Bough, and listen.
quests.turn_in_text:
Quiet at the shrine, quiet at the tower, and a groan at the end of the Rotting Bough that you felt in your feet. That's where it hurts.

The tree's groaned like that every night since the merge, and it's getting louder.

quests.title: Spores on the Wind
quests.description: Ganjo says the Rotspore Clouds drifting off the Rotting Bough carry the rot from branch to branch, and the wind's been blowing them toward the terraces.
quests.accept_text: The Rotspore Clouds drift off the Rotting Bough and settle wherever the wind drops them, and that's how the rot jumps from branch to branch. The wind's been blowing toward Heartwatch all week. Scatter them before they settle here.
quests.turn_in_text:
The air's clearer already. I can smell the lichen again instead of the rot.

The loa don't like the spores either. They went quiet when the clouds came, and they've started talking again.

quests.title: Pale Dust
quests.description: Ganjo burns the dust off Lichenwing Moths at the old shrines, because the smoke smells of rain and the loa like it. He wants enough to burn at every stone on the terraces.
quests.accept_text: The Lichenwing Moths along the terraces carry a pale dust on their wings, and when it burns it smells like rain. The loa like it. Bring me some, and I'll burn it at every stone the first climbers left.
quests.turn_in_text:
That's plenty, and it smells right.

The tree likes it too, I think. Last night was the first night in a month it didn't groan till dawn.

quests.title: Lotus for the Shrine
quests.description: Ganjo lays Purple Lotus at the old shrine on the Lichen Reach, as the first climbers did. Since the rot came, it's the only offering the tree takes.

objectives.label: Gather Purple Lotus on the boughs

quests.accept_text: The first climbers left Purple Lotus at their shrines, and since the rot came it's the only thing the tree seems to take. It grows out on the boughs. Bring me what you can and I'll lay it at the shrine on the Reach.
quests.turn_in_text:
The flowers wilt by morning now, every time. The first climbers wrote that they used to last a week.

The tree takes the offering. It's just hungrier than it was.

quests.title: Bad Sap
quests.description: Bark-Doctor Ezzi cuts the rot out of the bark where she can, but the Sap-Blight Oozes on the Rotting Bough seep back into every cut she makes.
quests.accept_text: Every time I cut a soft spot out of the bark, the Sap-Blight Oozes on the Rotting Bough seep into the wound and the rot comes back worse. Clear them out so the cuts can close and the bark's got a chance.
quests.turn_in_text:
The cuts I made yesterday are still clean this morning, and that's the first time in a month.

It's not a cure, but it's a start, and starts are what a doctor lives on.

quests.title: Splints for the Bark
quests.description: Ezzi packs the wounds she cuts in the bark with clean wood, so the tree grows over them instead of rotting. Thornveil from the boughs is the cleanest wood up here.

objectives.label: Gather Thornveil Wood on the boughs

quests.accept_text: When I cut the rot out, I pack the hole with clean wood so the tree heals over it. Thornveil's the cleanest wood on the boughs, and nothing rots it. Bring me some and I'll get to work.
quests.turn_in_text:
That's good wood, and it'll hold.

The newcomer doctor says a tree back where she's from heals the same way, it just doesn't take a whole bough to do it.

quests.title: Splinters for the Doctor
quests.description: Ezzi wants splinters of rotted heartwood from the Rotheart Treants on the Rotting Bough taken to Dr. Priya Raman, who's been trying to work out what the rot is.
quests.accept_text: Priya's been asking for proper samples of the rot, deep ones. The Rotheart Treants on the Rotting Bough are rotten right through, so their splinters will do. Bring them to her, not me, she knows what to look for.
quests.turn_in_text:
These are perfect, and look at the white threads running through them.

That's mycelium, all of it. It's a fungus, or something that grows like one. Ezzi was right to send these to me.

quests.title: Spore Samples
quests.description: Dr. Priya Raman is a plant pathologist from Bengaluru, and she wants spores from the Rotspore Clouds to see how the rot travels.
quests.accept_text: Back home in Bengaluru I'd culture the spores to find out what I'm dealing with. I haven't got a lab up here, but I've got eyes and a lot of patience. The Rotspore Clouds on the Rotting Bough carry sacs of them. Bring me some and don't squeeze them.
quests.turn_in_text:
Thank you, and you didn't squeeze them, which is more than the last person managed.

On Earth this would be a fungus. Here it's a fungus that's hungry, and that's not a thing fungi are supposed to be.

quests.title: Where It's Spreading
quests.description: Priya wants to see the rot's far end on the Rotting Bough for herself, but she's not a fighter. She'd like someone to go first and tell her what's there.

objectives.label: Look at the rot's far end on the Rotting Bough

quests.accept_text: Back home in Bengaluru I'd have a field team for this. Here I've got you, and I need to know if the rot's spreading out along the bough or just deeper into it. I'd go myself, but the Sap-Blight Oozes out there would have me for lunch. Go to the far end of the Rotting Bough, clear it, and tell me what the edge of the rot looks like.
quests.turn_in_text:
Deeper, not wider. It's going straight down into the bough, toward the trunk.

That's not how a rot spreads. That's how something feeds.

quests.title: What the Harpies Feed
quests.description: Priya thinks the rot is coming from somewhere inside the trunk. The harpies in Shriekhollow have been carrying grubs down into the hollow, and Scout Ree'na says they won't go past the eyrie.
quests.accept_text: The harpies carry grubs down into Shriekhollow and drop them past the eyrie, but they never follow. Something's at the bottom they're feeding. Go down past the eyrie, through the Rotdark Crawlers, and find out what it is. If it's what I think, Old Splinterheart is what the scouts have been calling it.
quests.turn_in_text:
A treant that grew inside the trunk, in the dark, on the rot, and the harpies kept it fed.

On Earth I'd have called it an opportunist. It wasn't the cause, I don't think. It was a symptom that got big enough to have a name.

quests.title: Notes for the Watch
quests.description: Priya has written up everything she knows about the rot, and she wants it in Shadow Hunter Vokra's hands before the tribes decide what to do about the Heartwood Hollow.

objectives.label: Take Priya's notes to Shadow Hunter Vokra at Heartwatch

quests.accept_text: I've written down everything, the spores, the splinters, the way it goes down instead of out. Vokra's the one who'll have to go through that door one day. Take her my notes, she'll want them more than I do.
quests.turn_in_text:
A fungus that eats like an animal, feeding something under the heartwood. I hoped the newcomer doctor would tell me I was wrong.

This goes to the High Chieftain tonight. Thank you for carrying it, and thank her for writing it.

on_accept.name: Priya's Notes on the Rot
on_accept.description: Pages of small, neat handwriting with sketches of spores and splinters, and one line underlined twice: it goes down, not out.

quests.title: Talons on the Hollow Bough
quests.description: Huntmaster Raz'gul says the harpies on the Hollow Bough have got bold since they started eating the rot's grubs. The Blighted Harpies and the Hollow Screechers lead every raid on the terraces.
quests.accept_text: The harpies came up from the coast after the merge and found the hollows in the south bough. Since they started eating the rot's grubs, every Blighted Harpy has got big and the Hollow Screechers have got loud. Thin them out on the Hollow Bough.
quests.turn_in_text:
That'll teach them the terraces aren't theirs.

They'll be back, they always are. But they'll come back fewer, and they'll come back careful.

quests.title: Feather-Knives
quests.description: The Hollow Talons throw knives of hardened feather from the hollows, and the Hollow Windcallers whip up the wind to carry them. Raz'gul wants both cut down.
quests.accept_text: The Hollow Talons throw knives cut from their own feathers, hard as bone, and the Hollow Windcallers call up a gust behind every throw. My scouts can't get near the hollows on the Hollow Bough, south-east of here. Take both down so they can.
quests.turn_in_text:
Ree'na got close enough to count the nests this morning, and she didn't come back bleeding for once.

That's the kind of progress I'll take.

quests.title: Old Raggedwing
quests.description: The oldest harpy on the Hollow Bough is half bald and twice as mean, and the flock follows her. Raz'gul calls her Old Raggedwing.
quests.accept_text: There's an old harpy on the Hollow Bough with half her feathers gone, and every raid on the terraces starts with her screaming. The others call her something we can't say. We call her Old Raggedwing, and I want her dead.
quests.turn_in_text:
Old Raggedwing's dead. The flock's been circling all afternoon and they can't decide what to do.

That's what I wanted. Now we go into the hollow while they're still arguing.

quests.title: Into Shriekhollow
quests.description: The harpies' matron, Matron Vyssa, keeps her eyrie inside the trunk in a hollow the trolls call Shriekhollow. With Old Raggedwing dead, Raz'gul wants the matron next.
quests.accept_text: Shriekhollow's in the trunk off the terraces, south of Heartwatch. Every Brood-Harpy roosts on the ledges inside, and Matron Vyssa keeps the eyrie at the top of the hollow's throat. Kill her and the flock breaks.
quests.turn_in_text:
Vyssa's dead and the hollow's gone quiet, which is a sound I've never heard from it.

You've done what we couldn't in a year. The terraces are ours again, and that's thanks to you.

quests.title: Still Twitching
quests.description: Scholar Nyara came up from the Settlement to study the thing that fell on the Lichen Reach a month ago. It hasn't stopped moving, and the Scuttling Gear-Drones keep crawling out of it.

objectives.label: Find the fallen construct at the end of the Lichen Reach

quests.accept_text: Something fell out of the clouds onto the end of the Lichen Reach, and it's still twitching. Little Scuttling Gear-Drones keep crawling out of it and going somewhere. Go and look at it for me, and stop the drones while you're there.
quests.turn_in_text:
Bronze, crystal and wire, and none of it made by anyone on the ground. It fell, it broke, and it kept working.

The drones were carrying pieces of bark back to it. It's been collecting the tree.

quests.title: Drone-Cogs
quests.description: Nyara wants cogs from the Scuttling Gear-Drones on the Lichen Reach, so she can see how they're made before the scholars in the Settlement start arguing about it.
quests.accept_text: Tel'zan will want to know how these things are built, and I want to know first. The Scuttling Gear-Drones on the Lichen Reach are full of little bronze cogs. Bring me some, and try not to bend them.
quests.turn_in_text:
Every tooth on every cog is cut exactly the same, to the width of a hair. No smith in the Settlement could do this.

Whoever made these was making them long before any of us climbed this tree.

quests.title: Scouts Without Masters
quests.description: Scout Mahu watches the wreck for Nyara. The bigger constructs on the Lichen Reach walk the bough and spark at anything that comes close. He calls them Twitching Scouts, and Nyara can't get near the wreck while they're there.
quests.accept_text: The Twitching Scouts walk up and down the Lichen Reach as if somebody told them to guard it and then never came back. They spark at anything that moves, and they won't let Nyara near it. Bring them down.
quests.turn_in_text:
Nyara got all the way to the wreck this morning. There's a sort of eye in the middle of it, she says, and it watched her the whole time.

The biggest one's still out there, and it's the one doing the watching.

quests.title: The Wakened Surveyor
quests.description: The largest construct on the Lichen Reach woke when the wreck fell and has been walking the bough ever since, turning a beam of light on the trunk. Nyara calls it the Wakened Surveyor.
quests.accept_text: The big one on the Reach, the one I call the Wakened Surveyor, turns a beam of light on the trunk and holds it there, like it's measuring something. Stop it, and bring me back whatever's left of its core.
quests.turn_in_text:
You've brought its core back, and it's still warm. Hold it up to the light and you can see marks scratched inside the crystal.

They're measurements, hundreds of them, and every single one is of the tree.

quests.title: The Surveyor's Core
quests.description: Nyara wants the Wakened Surveyor's core taken down to Archivist Tel'zan in the scholars' hall in the Great Settlement, for the record of everything that's fallen from the sky.

objectives.label: Take the Surveyor's core to Archivist Tel'zan in the Great Settlement

quests.accept_text: Tel'zan keeps the record of everything that's fallen out of the sky, and he's going to want this more than anything he's got. Take it down the High Lift to the scholars' hall at the Roost.
quests.turn_in_text:
Measurements of the tree, all of them, and the oldest ones scratched in long before the tree was this tall.

Someone up there has been watching it grow. I've never written a worse line in the record.

on_accept.name: The Surveyor's Core
on_accept.description: A fist of crystal from the Wakened Surveyor's chest, still warm. Fine marks are scratched inside it, row after row.

quests.title: Owls on the Terraces
quests.description: Stonekeeper Jo'than keeps the first climbers' terraces swept, and the Mistfeather Owls that nest in the old towers have started taking the outpost's birds.
quests.accept_text: The Mistfeather Owls nest in the old towers along the terraces, and they've started taking Heartwatch's message birds out of the air. I've got nothing against an owl, but those birds are how we talk to the city. Thin them out along the terraces.
quests.turn_in_text:
The birds made it down to the Settlement and back today, both of them.

The owls are older up here than we are. I don't like killing them, but I like losing birds less.

quests.title: Skinks in the Stonework
quests.description: The Terrace Skinks dig their nests between the old stones, and every nest loosens a block the first climbers set by hand.
quests.accept_text: The Terrace Skinks dig in between the stones to nest, and every nest they dig loosens a block. These terraces were carried up a tree a block at a time, and I won't lose them to lizards. Clear them off.
quests.turn_in_text:
I've reset four blocks this afternoon and none of them wobbled.

The first climbers would have sat on that wall and laughed at me for fussing. I fuss anyway, because they can't.

quests.title: The Climbers' Names
quests.description: Jo'than keeps the names of the first climbers, cut in the stones they left up and down the terraces. Some of them are wearing away, and he wants them read while they still can be.

objectives.label: Read the names on the cairn on the north terraces
Read the names at the foot of the Root Stair
Read the names on the tower on the south terraces

quests.accept_text: The first climbers cut their names in the stones they set. There's a cairn on the north terraces, the foot of the Root Stair going on up the trunk, and the old tower on the south terraces. Read me what's still there, and I'll cut it fresh.
quests.turn_in_text:
Some of those names I'd lost already, and you've brought them back. Most of them were cut long before the merge.

The one at the stair goes on past where the stair does now. Somebody climbed higher than we've ever been, and cut their name on the way.

quests.title: Hushwing
quests.description: The oldest owl on the terraces is bigger than a troll and makes no sound at all. The first climbers carved her on their stones, and she's started hunting the outpost's people.
quests.accept_text: There's an owl on the terraces the first climbers carved on their stones, and she's still alive, if you can believe it. We call her Hushwing. She's never troubled us, but last week she took a hunter off the south terraces. Whatever's wrong with the tree, it's got into her too. Put her down.
quests.turn_in_text:
She was old when the first climbers came, and she'd have been old when the tree was small.

I'll cut her on the cairn beside them. She was one of the terraces, in her way.

quests.title: Moths in the Ropes
quests.description: Ropehand Dezza works the top of the High Lift, and the Lichenwing Moths have been laying eggs in its ropes. The grubs that hatch eat the fibres.
quests.accept_text: The Lichenwing Moths lay their eggs in the High Lift's ropes, and the grubs eat the fibres from the inside. One day a rope's going to go with a full basket on it. Knock the moths out of the air along the terraces.
quests.turn_in_text:
I've checked every rope from top to bottom, and they're clean.

One of the newcomers told me there's a moth back where she's from that eats clothes. I didn't believe her until I saw these.

quests.title: Up the Root Stair
quests.description: Ropehand Dezza hears everything that comes up and down the tree. Windwarden Kazra'jin, who keeps Highrest on the Upper Boughs, has asked Heartwatch for someone who can fight in the wind.

objectives.label: Climb the Root Stair and give Dezza's knot to Windwarden Kazra'jin at Highrest

quests.accept_text: Kazra'jin keeps Highrest, the last camp before the cloud, and he's asked Heartwatch for a fighter. After what you did at the Hollow there's nobody else I'd send. Take him my knot so he knows it's me who sent you. The Root Stair climbs the trunk above Heartwatch, and it doesn't stop till Highrest.
quests.turn_in_text:
That's Dezza's knot, and she only ties that one for people she'd trust with a rope.

Welcome to Highrest. Mind the wind, because it doesn't care who you are. Sit, eat, and then I'll tell you what we need.

on_accept.name: Dezza's Knot
on_accept.description: A short length of lift rope tied in a knot only Dezza uses, three loops and a twist, hard as wood.

quests.title: Pythons in the Lichen
quests.description: Scout Mahu watches the Lichen Reach, and the Mistcoil Pythons lie flat in the lichen where nobody sees them until they're stepped on.
quests.accept_text: The Mistcoil Pythons lie flat in the lichen on the Reach, grey on grey, and you don't see one until it's got your leg. I've been bitten twice this month. Clear them off the Reach so I can watch the wreck in peace.
quests.turn_in_text:
I walked the whole Reach this morning without looking at my feet once.

Now I can watch the wreck properly. It's still twitching, if you were wondering.

quests.title: Counting Nests
quests.description: Scout Ree'na counts the harpies' nests for Raz'gul, so he knows how big the flock's got. She needs someone to look into the great hollow on the fork and the roosts along the Hollow Bough.

objectives.label: Look into the harpies' great hollow on the fork
Count the roosts along the Hollow Bough

quests.accept_text: Raz'gul wants a count of the nests, and I can't get close without being seen. Look into the great hollow out east on the fork and walk the roosts along the Hollow Bough, and tell me how many you see.
quests.turn_in_text:
That's twice what I counted last month. They're breeding on the rot's grubs.

Raz'gul's not going to like this, and I'm the one who has to tell him.
